title: Praveen Kumar: more Figma dither shaders (brain, petals, horse, hibiscus)
note: More dither inspo. Praveen Kumar posted '@figma dither shaders magic' on 2026-11-27, following his earlier dither set. Four square single-colour dithers on white: a brain cross-section in cornflower blue, translucent hydrangea petals in red-orange, a galloping horse fading to dots in navy, and a close-up hibiscus in indigo. Images are the post's own four.
